source.organization: Open Knowledge Foundation Deutschland e.V. / OpenCorporates
source.license: CC-BY 4.0 (per OffeneRegister); mirror tags CC-BY-NC 4.0 — confirm
source.attribution: Contains data from OpenCorporates, made available by Open Knowledge Foundation Deutschland (OffeneRegister.de) under CC-BY 4.0. Do not market the data as 'Handelsregister'/'Commercial Register'.

access.note: License is the main risk: CC-BY vs CC-BY-NC unresolved. Treat as NonCommercial until confirmed.

transport.record_path: $ (one JSON object per line after bzip2 decompression)

pagination.note: Single bulk file (~260 MB compressed / ~4 GB decompressed). Alt: handelsregister.db SQLite 3.7 GB (2022); openregister.db.gz 773 MB (2019).

snapshot.note: Stream-decompress; do NOT load ~4 GB into memory. Persist raw archive in raw/bulk/.

parsing.notes: company_number / _registerNummer MUST stay strings (leading zeros / court scope). all_attributes is a nested object with mixed-language values. officers[] is PII — gate persistence behind GDPR policy. No NACE/tax_id/VAT/incorporation date present.

mapping_rules.company_type: Derive from the legal-form suffix in name and/or all_attributes._registerArt.
mapping_rules.natural_register_key: Compose all_attributes.registrar + '_' + _registerArt + '_' + _registerNummer; expose native_company_number as the human reference.
mapping_rules.officers: Map officers[] to a separate company_officers table keyed by company_number (PII).
mapping_rules.address: registered_address is free text — parse downstream; municipality from all_attributes.registered_office, region from all_attributes.federal_state.

fixture_requirements: HRB Kapitalgesellschaft (GmbH) with multiple officers and additional_data flags
record with previous_names and subsequent_registrations populated
record with an officer that has end_date + dismissed=true

live_test_plan.smoke: Download a few KB, bunzip2 a handful of lines, assert company_number + name + all_attributes._registerArt present.
live_test_plan.full: Stream the full bz2 behind an env gate; decompress line by line; persist raw archive; normalize to NDJSON; split officers to a side table.

blockers: License ambiguity CC-BY vs CC-BY-NC must be resolved before any commercial use/redistribution.
Data is stale (2017-2019). For more recent coverage evaluate the 2022 SQLite snapshot or a commercial API.
